First, we take the derivative of each term and then add them:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,(4sec⁡x+{e}^{x}) \\  & =4sec⁡xtan⁡x+{e}^{x}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $x=0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}{|}_{x=0} & =(4sec⁡xtan⁡x+{e}^{x})\,{|}_{x=0} \\  & =4sec⁡(0)tan⁡(0)+{e}^{0} \\  & =4\cdot 1\cdot 0+1 \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
